name: spinner
title: Spinner
purpose: Announce and visualize an indeterminate operation with no measurable completion value.
accessibility: Uses a polite status role with an accessible label.
Visible labels are hidden from duplicate announcement.
Animation stops under reduced motion while the ring remains visible.
commonMistakes: Using several unrelated spinners in one compact region.

examples.title: Compact status
examples.description: Keep the loading name accessible when visual space is tight.
examples.source:
<script setup lang="ts">
import Spinner from "@/components/ui/Spinner.vue";
</script>

<template>
  <Spinner label="Loading placeholder" size="sm" />
</template>
